items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: My father was actually the first one to become a musician, even though my uncle Bruz was older.

ctx.x: And King Oliver and all those?

Yes. He lived with, when he first came up he stayed with my grandparents. And so my grandfather was also a piano player. And so my dad grew up listening to Louis Armstrong play duets with my grandfather, and my dad and his two brothers of course. My father was actually the first one to become a musician, even though my uncle Bruz was older. He’s the oldest of the three. But he also has another history because he was a Tuskegee Airman. And he also served with Percy Heath. Percy Heath is a Tuskegee Airman. So a lot…
